WITH RankedBatsmen AS (
    SELECT
        m.season_id,
        p.player_name,
        p.player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY SUM(bs.runs_scored) DESC, p.player_id ASC) as rank
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN match m ON bs.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON bs.match_id = bbb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bbb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    JOIN player p ON bbb.striker = p.player_id
    GROUP BY m.season_id, p.player_id, p.player_name
),
RankedBowlers AS (
    SELECT
        m.season_id,
        p.player_name,
        p.player_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_wickets,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, p.player_id ASC) as rank
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN match m ON wt.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON wt.match_id = bbb.match_id AND wt.over_id = bbb.over_id AND wt.ball_id = bbb.ball_id AND wt.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    JOIN player p ON bbb.bowler = p.player_id
    WHERE wt.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
    GROUP BY m.season_id, p.player_id, p.player_name
),
TopBatsmen AS (
    SELECT
        season_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN player_name END) AS batsman_1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN total_runs END) AS total_runs_1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN player_name END) AS batsman_2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN total_runs END) AS total_runs_2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN player_name END) AS batsman_3,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN total_runs END) AS total_runs_3
    FROM RankedBatsmen
    WHERE rank <= 3
    GROUP BY season_id
),
TopBowlers AS (
    SELECT
        season_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN player_name END) AS bowler_1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN total_wickets END) AS total_wickets_1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN player_name END) AS bowler_2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN total_wickets END) AS total_wickets_2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN player_name END) AS bowler_3,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN total_wickets END) AS total_wickets_3
    FROM RankedBowlers
    WHERE rank <= 3
    GROUP BY season_id
)
SELECT
    b.season_id,
    b.batsman_1,
    b.total_runs_1,
    bo.bowler_1,
    bo.total_wickets_1,
    b.batsman_2,
    b.total_runs_2,
    bo.bowler_2,
    bo.total_wickets_2,
    b.batsman_3,
    b.total_runs_3,
    bo.bowler_3,
    bo.total_wickets_3
FROM TopBatsmen b
JOIN TopBowlers bo ON b.season_id = bo.season_id
ORDER BY b.season_id;
